scope: Read-only source and aggregate benchmark comparison; no new GPU inference, training, model activation or deployment was performed. Peer figures are author reports on different protocols, not a leaderboard.

our_baseline.accuracy: 34/40 (85%); TP15, FN6, TN19, FP0; recall 71.43%; observed precision 100%
our_baseline.scope: Exposed development regression; direct analyzer run, not a new 40-video public API quality run; no validated type accuracy or unseen-camera score.
our_baseline.timing: Direct analyzer: median31.320s, max97.710s, four evaluator slots. Fresh six-concurrent public API: median92.076s, max142.568s, all6 completed; warm GPU-host client, includes upload/queue/polling and excludes19.261s preparation.
our_baseline.model: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct, BF16, vLLM, A10080GB; per-video layout, repeated full-scene/crop states, temporal rules and candidate verification.

peers.name: AliNurym / CashGuard
peers.approach: RT-DETR + OWLv2, DINOv2 crop-state heads, targeted Qwen4B.
peers.timing: L4: reported API median14s/max62s; six longest together finish by195s.
peers.adopt: Event-driven questions (typically0–5, cap12), masked safe crops, tiled desk cash, learned states.
peers.caveat: Deployed classifiers fitted on all40; setup LOSO does not hold out all system development. Safe-state transfer remains weak.

peers.name: rsduv
peers.approach: Faster R-CNN MobileNet + targeted OWLv2 + geometry/time rules.
peers.adopt: Use cheap people/object observations for persistent scene facts and event anchors.
peers.caveat: Same-set thresholds and camera proxies; silent time-budget truncation can become a clean verdict. Do not copy those behaviors.

peers.name: Hotel-zulu — refreshed
peers.approach: Fine-tuned RT-DETRv2, people detector, IoU tracks and temporal rules; no VLM verifier.
peers.quality: Updated source now35/42 (83.3%); TP15/FN7, FP0/TN20; median timecode1.6s; type14/15. Previous report snapshot was34/42.
peers.timing: M4 claim8–10fps; estimated150s for five-minute video, not a full API latency distribution.
peers.adopt: Bank-domain detector classes and 2-of-5-frame object persistence.
peers.caveat: 42rows include duplicate videos; final training includes validation data and rule thresholds use same set. Not an independent test.

peers.name: tztzlk / CompVision
peers.approach: RT-DETR + OWLv2 zones + SigLIP crop states and learned heads, temporal hysteresis/rules.
peers.quality: No published whole-video confusion matrix. Cash-crop grouped OOF AUC0.987 is a component metric.
peers.adopt: Small crop-state heads, separate on/off thresholds, event histories and precise transition anchors.
peers.caveat: AUC is not violation accuracy. Pose gesture classifiers still generated5–11 false alarms among19 clean videos and remain disabled.

peers.name: i-oeng / Veriti v12
peers.timing: Reported max181s; separate8GB and24GB model hosts.
peers.adopt: High-recall proposals can be evaluated in shadow mode to find missed candidates.
peers.caveat: 50% false-alarm rate on clean rows. Full v12 lower accuracy than lite v11. Avoid a broad production review pass or copying its operating point.

priorities.name: Replace repeated VLM state questions with tracked, learned scene states
priorities.benefit: Largest plausible coupled speed/consistency improvement; an experiment, not an established gain.
priorities.adopt: CashGuard event-triggered query scheduling and DINOv2/CompVision SigLIP state heads.
priorities.change: Add a replacement observation producer: cheap people/object tracks → compact shared crop encoder → calibrated cash/safe/screen/presence states → temporal transitions. Invoke q30 for uncertainty and event verification; preserve periodic whole-video coverage and a union of proposal signals.
priorities.current: Our accepted run uses5745 Qwen calls/40clips (143.625 per clip). Full-frame plus up to4 region questions repeat at every state sample. Crops, factual prompts, rules and verification already exist; those are not new features to add.
priorities.acceptance: Measure state recall, full-video verdicts, candidate recall, VLM call/token counts, latency and fallback rate. Keep at least current15/21 positives, all19 clean negatives and zero processing failures on regression; freeze a separate camera/setup evaluation for generalization.

priorities.name: Use dense local action windows and better event timestamps
priorities.benefit: Targets brief-event misses and localization while keeping broad scanning inexpensive.
priorities.adopt: Event anchors from tracking, minimum durations, hysteresis and event-history guards.
priorities.change: Expand original-frame sampling near departures, client changes, object appearance/disappearance and uncertain hand/device activity. Keep action onset separate from the later time at which enough evidence confirms it. Recheck supported event intervals with the current verifier.
priorities.current: State sampling is capped at100 samples and at most1Hz. A142s clip therefore has a nominal spacing around1.42s. Verification then reduces a roughly8s window to10 sampled frames. The accepted confirmation change removed1 false alarm but nearest-event median error worsened1.0→1.5s and within2s hits12→11.
priorities.acceptance: Review event type/start/end, actor, object and visibility on permitted material; one-to-one type/time matching. Maintain a uniform coverage floor; do not turn unobserved ID/device/counting actions into proof of omission.

priorities.name: Broaden domain-specific perception and complete procedural fact producers
priorities.benefit: Needed to address missing violation categories; public object training alone is insufficient.
priorities.adopt: Hotel-style dedicated domain classes and persistent object tracks, trained against difficult normal examples.
priorities.change: Use authorized own/permitted data for keys in locks, cups/coats/bags, small ID versus notes, hand/device interactions, actor roles and transaction boundaries. Qualify object classes, then qualify each procedural type separately. Start with observable states and simple temporal logic before a new temporal transformer.
priorities.current: RF-DETR+ByteTrack, RTMPose, temporal checks and a transformer interface already exist, but are inactive/unqualified. The public RF candidate covers cards/notes, missed3/16 IDs and has6 banknote false positives. Crop2B primary macro score94.53125% failed its95% gate and did not test absence or procedural actions.
priorities.acceptance: Camera/setup-grouped class and complete-video tests, hard negatives, event-level precision/recall and full visibility. New types require their own approved producer and release gate. Do not enable staged weights simply because they trained successfully.

priorities.name: Profile and test small existing scheduling optimizations
priorities.benefit: Lower implementation cost; likely smaller upside than replacing the state producer.
priorities.adopt: Use existing parallel_layout first; test verify_concise separately after agreement checks. Measure batching and expensive detector cadence in a future replacement producer.
priorities.change: Record queue, decode, layout, state questions, verification, evidence, prefill/decode tokens and fallback counts for the accepted q30 pipeline. Test one flag at a time against frozen regression and identical hardware/network load. Detector inference should use a measured sampling/batching policy with dense windows when needed.
priorities.current: parallel_layout, verify_concise, job_priority and change_gating already exist, default off. Earlier staged-concise results belong to another architecture and do not establish a q30 gain. Prefix/multimodal caching and bounded admission already exist. Current summaries do not isolate exact state/verify or GPU-prefill percentages.
priorities.acceptance: Identical verdicts, no lost true positives, validated timestamps/evidence, zero failures; compare direct and public API timings separately. Change gating needs brief-event recall tests; job priority changes completion order rather than total GPU work.

priorities.name: Test a smaller VLM only on the focused questions
priorities.benefit: Potential serving-cost/latency reduction after request sparsification; no automatic speedup from a smaller model name.
priorities.adopt: Targeted4B door/screen verification, not an unrestricted whole-video violation search.
priorities.change: Benchmark a compact model on frozen crop/window tasks with ambiguous, absent-object and clean examples. Keep q30 fallback until complete-video and load results support promotion.
priorities.current: No compact candidate is qualified for our actual scene/verification tasks. The2B adapter’s oracle-box card-versus-note metric is a different task. Veriti’s larger reviewer harmed overall accuracy, illustrating why parameter count alone is a poor selection rule.
priorities.acceptance: Task-level accuracy, uncertain rate, calibrated thresholds and full-video type/time/evidence results on the same hardware; count cascade fallback work and both models’ memory. Retain q30 unless quality and operational gates pass.

implementation_gaps.title: Specialists currently add work; they do not replace the VLM state producer.
implementation_gaps.detail: The service processes native-frame specialist perception under one lock and then analyze() still runs the usual VLM states before specialist proposals. Enabling specialists alone can increase latency. A replacement producer and measured detector batching/cadence are required.

implementation_gaps.title: Long-video sampling can conflict with specialist departure continuity.
implementation_gaps.detail: The100-state cap makes long-video spacing exceed1s, while _state_departures requires adjacent supporting observations within specialist_max_gap_s=1.1 and a sustained absence interval. This can prevent support on a142s clip. Generate denser role observations or explicitly reconcile sampling with coverage; do not increase a gap allowance and claim missing frames were observed. This is a dormant-path issue, not an established explanation for the current six misses.

implementation_gaps.title: LEFT_DURING_SERVICE still needs its own specialist producer.
implementation_gaps.detail: The type is protected/disabled and is absent from specialist and tracked-head supported sets. Broad detector weights or a switch cannot establish completed service, actor roles or a departure-during-service event.

experiment_order: CPU/source-level sampling and producer-contract checks, then isolated parallel_layout agreement/latency trial.
Train/calibrate narrow crop states on permitted camera-grouped data and evaluate as shadow proposals with q30 fallback.
Replace repeated state requests only after state/event regression evidence; benchmark one request, four active jobs and six public uploads on the same host.
Use separate reviewed type/time/camera tests for accuracy gains; target at least one additional valid positive without losing existing correct verdicts or adding false alarms.
Evaluate compact focused VLM and deployment tuning only after request scheduling is efficient.
guardrails: Keep current verification: it removed one observed false alarm.
No blind reduction of temporal sampling, global threshold relaxation, broad second-pass recall mode or activation of unqualified weights.
Do not translate crop AUC, object recall, test counts or all-positive F1 into bank-video accuracy.
The exposed40-video suite remains regression; a fresh camera/setup test is needed for generalization.
No estimated speed multiplier or under30s guarantee is established by this comparison.
